# DeepSeek API Reference for AI Agents

> Single-file, agent-optimized reference documentation for the DeepSeek API — covering Chat Completions, Thinking/Reasoning Mode, FIM, Tool Calling, Streaming, Context Caching, and OpenAI/Anthropic SDK compatibility.

## Core Documentation

- [DeepSeek API Complete Developer Reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prakhargaba007/deepseek-agent-docs/main/deepseek.md): Complete single-file documentation covering authentication, models, endpoints, parameters, features, thinking mode, SDK examples, rate limits, error codes, and best practices.
